title: The Social Laboratory: A Psychometric Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Evaluation
reasoning: The paper includes a component evaluating models on religion and ethics by utilizing the Change-My-View (CMV) dataset, which specifically contains controversial prompts related to religion and ethics. Furthermore, one of the primary agent personas used in the framework is a 'values-focused ethicist', and the study examines the model's ability to de-bias and reach consensus on these sensitive topics.
